what: The Q1 diagram at the top of the Exercise block: a vertical pink bar labelled 'IDL' running down the middle of the page, with a pair of boxes on either side of it. Row (A) — left box reads '150° E Meridian, Monday, 15th August', an arrow runs left-to-right across the IDL to a right box that reads '150° W Meridian' with its day/date line left blank. Row (B) — right box reads '170° W Meridian, Sunday 25th December', an arrow runs right-to-left across the IDL to a left box that reads '80° E Meridian' with its day/date line left blank. The arrow direction (west-to-east in A, east-to-west in B) is what tells the student whether to keep or advance the date, so the figure is needed to answer.
